thread:
Maya: Quick sync — I'm proposing a small SDK auth surface change to simplify service-account -> OIDC flows. TL;DR: add an optional project_hint (string) to the SA credentials so client libs can try project-scoped audiences before falling back. Thoughts?

Darren: Sounds useful, we hit this with cross-org tokens last week. How will this interact with impersonation and existing audience rewriting? Example usage would help.

Maya: Example (Node):
```js
const creds = new ServiceAccount({ key: process.env.SA_KEY, project_hint: 'org-42' });
await client.authenticate(creds);
// SDK will first attempt aud = `projects/123/locations/...` if hint is provided, then fall back to default aud behavior
```

Sam: I like the hint but worried about leaking org/project identifiers in configs. Can we make it opt-in (explicit env var + config) and require allowlisting?

Maya: Totally — proposal: the constructor accepts project_hint but the runtime only honors it when env REDWOOD_SA_HINT_ALLOWLIST contains the target org (comma-separated). Default is empty = disabled. Also emit an anonymized telemetry event when hint is used.

Leo: For strongly typed libs (Go/Python) I'd prefer an options pattern so we don't change stable constructors. e.g., Go: WithProjectHint("org-42") to return a functional option. Keeps it non-breaking.

Darren: Two runtime notes from infra: 1) If we try an alternate aud and get 401, SDK should perform one automatic audience-rewrite+retry (not infinite retries). 2) Streaming clients need special care — immediate retry can deadlock some gRPC streams we saw. Use a jittered backoff before the retry.

Sam: Agree on the one-shot retry + backoff. Also, on streaming reauth we must preserve local KV/model caches; only refresh the auth token. If we swap audiences and reissue full handshake it could flush caches leading to perf regressions.

Maya: Good call. So behavior: attempt original aud -> if 401 AND project_hint present -> wait jitter(200-800ms) -> attempt rewritten aud once -> if still 401 -> surface error. Streaming: do token-only reauth where possible, else full reconnect with cache retention flag.

Darren: We'll need unit tests for both binary and streaming flows. Also add an integration test that sets REDWOOD_SA_HINT_ALLOWLIST to ensure it's only honored when allowed. Mark the flaky stream auth test as skipped until we have the token-only path.

Maya: Will add tests. Security review required for telemetry and allowlist design — @Sam can you shepherd? :pray:

devex-bot: Created ticket DE-1623: "SDK: project_hint for SA->OIDC audience fallback" and linked RFC draft: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/DE-1623. Assigned: Maya, reviewers: Leo, Darren, Sam.

Maya: Thanks bot. I'll open a small PR with Node + Python PoC today and tag @Leo for Go API suggestion tomorrow. PR will show: constructor option (Node), functional option (Go), env allowlist, minimal telemetry, and unit tests for aud fallback + streaming token-only reauth.

Darren: lgtm. Add a short migration note in SDK changelog and a snippet for ops on how to set REDWOOD_SA_HINT_ALLOWLIST in Kubernetes (example below).

Sam: I'll draft the security blurb for the changelog and checklist.

Leo: Prototype incoming — I'll post a Go snippet in the thread. Quick idea:
```go
opts := []SvcOpt{WithKey(key)}
if hint != "" { opts = append(opts, WithProjectHint(hint)) }
creds := NewServiceAccount(opts...)
```

Maya: Perfect. Ops example for k8s (Darren asked):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  REDWOOD_SA_HINT_ALLOWLIST: "org-42,org-99"
```

Maya: Thanks all — I'll post RFC edits and the PR link here once opened. :rocket:
